ownerHint: Without this password, PidiElf leaves the restrictions in place.
usesShared: The shared password will be tried on this file.

policy.known: PidiElf only removes protection with a password you know.
policy.never: It never guesses or bypasses a password, and never stores one.
policy.owner: A file that opens freely but forbids printing, copying or editing needs its owner password.

status.open: Protected by a password to open.
status.restricted: Opens without a password, but with restrictions: {{list}}. Lifting them takes the owner password.
status.restrictedOther: Opens without a password, but with restrictions. Lifting them takes the owner password.
status.free: Restrictions set without any password: they will be removed.
status.none: This file is not protected: there is nothing to remove, it will be left out.
status.damaged: This file is unreadable or damaged: it will be left out.

failure.bad-password: This is not the right password. Check capitals and spaces, then try again.
failure.owner-required: This file opens without a password: only its owner password can lift its restrictions.

nothing_one: This file is not protected: there is nothing to unlock.
nothing_other: None of these files is protected: there is nothing to unlock.
needPassword_other: Enter the password of at least one file.
summary_one: The file's protection will be removed.
summary_other: The protection of all {{count}} files will be removed.
summaryPartial: {{ready}} of {{total}} files will be unlocked; the others will be left out.
note_one: Protection removed: this file now opens without a password or restrictions.
note_other: Protection removed: these files now open without a password or restrictions.
